title: What The Cello Knows — EN/IT/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 100bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal music philosophy Italian French language learning
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The cello sits in the register between the violin and the bass
It occupies the middle of the orchestra's harmonic space
Which is the most important place to be and the most overlooked
The cello is the instrument that held the whole thing booked

[Verse 2 — Italian, with English translation]
Il violoncello siede nel registro tra il violino e il basso
[The cello sits in the register between the violin and the bass]
Occupa lo spazio armonico al centro — niente è allo stesso passo
[It occupies the harmonic space at the centre — nothing is at the same pace]
È il luogo più importante dell'orchestra e il meno notato
[It is the most important place in the orchestra and the least noticed]
Il violoncello è lo strumento che tiene tutto accordato
[The cello is the instrument that keeps everything in tune]

[Chorus — English]
What does the cello know that I don't know?
It knows the warmth between the highest and the lowest note below
What does the cello know in the middle register?
It knows that the most important things are never on the poster
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
Le violoncelle occupe le registre entre le violon et la basse
[The cello occupies the register between the violin and the bass]
Il est le cœur harmonique de l'orchestre — sa masse
[It is the harmonic heart of the orchestra — its mass]
C'est l'endroit le plus important mais le moins remarqué
[It is the most important place but the least noticed]
Le violoncelle sait que tenir le milieu est la dignité
[The cello knows that holding the middle is dignity]

[Outro — All three languages]
What the cello knows… Quello che sa il violoncello… Ce que sait le violoncelle
The middle holds everything — Il centro tiene tutto — Le centre tient tout
That's my boy
